controles.affirmation: Le flux de tresorerie disponible s'est etabli a -2 061 M$ sur le premier semestre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Net cash provided by operating activities $ 3,639 $ 4,087 ... Capital expenditures ( 6,323 ) ( 5,700 ) (six mois clos le 30 juin 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: -2 061 M$ est le FCF du SEUL T2 2026 (KPI fcf_q, Q2-2026). Le FCF du premier semestre 2026 est de -2 684 M$ (3 639 - 6 323). Ecrire 'au deuxieme trimestre 2026' ou corriger le montant semestriel.

controles.affirmation: le flux de tresorerie operationnel a recule de 14,3% a 906 M$ [sur le premier semestre 2026]
controles.verbatim_source: Net cash provided by operating activities decreased by $448 million, or 11%, during the six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the same period in 2025.
controles.correction_proposee: Sur le premier semestre 2026 l'OCF est de 3 639 M$, en recul de 11%. 906 M$ (-14,3%) est le chiffre du T2 2026 seul.

controles.affirmation: les investissements industriels sont restes massifs a 2 967 M$ [sur la meme periode, S1 2026]
controles.correction_proposee: Le capex du premier semestre 2026 est de 6 323 M$. 2 967 M$ est le capex du T2 2026 seul.

controles.affirmation: un plan d'investissement annuel visant environ 11,8 Mds $ / un plan de capex de pres de 11,8 Mds $ par an
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q cite 12,4 Mds $ de capex pour 2026 (et le KPI capex_q precise 'plan 2026-2030 de 12,4 a 16,3 Mds $/an'). 11,787 Mds $ est le realise FY2025. Remplacer par 'un plan de 12,4 a 16,3 Mds $ par an sur 2026-2030'.

controles.affirmation: PG&E declare qu'elle 'believes it is probable that it will incur a loss' et a enregistre un passif de 300 M$ sur les Wildfire-Related Securities Claims
controles.verbatim_source: PG&E Corporation believes it is probable that it will incur a loss in connection with these matters. PG&E Corporation has recorded a liability in the aggregate amount of $ 300 million ... believes that it is reasonably possible that the amount of loss could be greater or less than the accrued estimated amount

controles.affirmation: les liabilites du Dixie fire 2021 ont deja depasse la couverture assurantielle
controles.verbatim_source: Recorded liabilities in connection with the 2021 Dixie fire have exceeded potential amounts recoverable under applicable insurance policies.

controles.affirmation: la notation de credit non garantie reste sous investment grade chez une agence majeure, avec risque de collateral supplementaire
controles.verbatim_source: remains below investment grade with one of the major credit rating agencies, the Utility generally does not receive unsecured credit from its energy procurement counterparties, and it may be required to increase its collateral postings if its credit rating is downgraded

controles.affirmation: Le 7 mai 2026, demande de reconnaissance tarifaire interimaire de 55%, 75% ou 85% (653 M$, 891 M$, 1,01 Md $), opposee par des intervenants, briefs 2 juillet et 23 juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On May 7, 2026, the Utility requested interim rate recovery effective January 1, 2027, of 55%, 75%, or 85% of its requested 2027 revenue requirement (approximately $653 million, $891 million, and $1.01 billion, respectively), which has been opposed by some intervenors. Opening briefs were filed on July 2, 2026, and reply briefs will be filed by July 23, 2026.

controles.affirmation: Le 4 aout 2026 l'Utility a finalise 1,7 Md $ de First Mortgage Bonds a 5,250% (2032) et 5,850% (2036)
controles.verbatim_source: $700,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.250% First Mortgage Bonds due 2032 ... $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.850% First Mortgage Bonds due 2036 ... On August 4, 2026, the Utility completed the sale of the Mortgage Bonds.

controles.affirmation: Dette LT 61 768 M$, dette nette 63 246 M$, capitaux propres 33 901 M$ au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Long-term debt (includes $ 11.6 billion and $ 11.7 billion related to VIEs at respective dates) 61,768 57,387 ... Total shareholders' equity 33,901 32,540

controles.affirmation: ROE 9,98% CPUC (-2,9% sur un an) contre ROE de base FERC de 10,38% approuve en aout 2025 pour le TO21
controles.verbatim_source: On August 5, 2025, the FERC issued a decision approving the settlement ... The decision set a base ROE of 10.38%

controles.affirmation: Le resultat net de PG&E a bondi de 37% au premier semestre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Net Income 831 612 1,785 1,307 (Pacific Gas and Electric Company) / Net Income $ 761 $ 549 $ 1,646 $ 1,183 (PG&E Corporation)
controles.correction_proposee: Le +37% est celui de l'Utility (Pacific Gas and Electric Company). Pour PG&E Corporation, l'entite cotee sous PCG, la hausse S1 est de +39,1% (1 646 vs 1 183) et de +41,0% sur le resultat disponible pour les actionnaires ordinaires (1 591 vs 1 128). Preciser l'entite.

controles.affirmation: cible de payout ratio d'environ 20% du benefice de base d'ici 2028 ; absence d'emission d'actions jusqu'en 2030
controles.verbatim_source: payout ratio of approximately 20% of core earnings by 2028 ... PG&E Corporation does not expect to undertake any equity issuances through 2030.
